title: evidence_item
description: A single piece of forensic evidence produced by a tool wrapper. All wrappers use BaseWrapper.make_evidence_item() to produce these.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for this piece of evidence within its source tool (e.g., 'proc_1234', 'conn_192.168.1.1_443')

source_tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this evidence (e.g., 'volatility3', 'tshark', 'regripper')

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp when the evidence was created/discovered, empty if unknown

confidence.description: Tool-reported confidence (0.0–1.0) in the accuracy of this evidence

linked_artifacts.description: Array of other artifact_ids that this evidence relates to (e.g., a process linked to a network connection)

normalized_value.description: Normalized value used for correlation (trimmed, canonicalized)

machine_id.description: Identifier for the machine/host this evidence belongs to

correlations.description: Correlation entries attached to this item
